method: Both reviewers read every German string of the current file (mtime 2026-09-28 00:56 UTC, written after r2). That covers title and title.canDo, the Folge (10 lines, gist item, 2 glosses), the 3 inputs (30 lines, the LS1 ad text, the LS3 note), the 7 exam texts, both strategy cards and the 8 redemittel with their function labels. It covers both speaking parts: instructions, situations, cards, openingLine, 8 hintWords, 16 model turns and the aiRole persona. It covers the S1 form (situation, taskDe, 5 labels, checklist, model text), the check line, the story beat and cliffhanger, and every endLine, promptDe, option and explanation.de. It also covers the two rule cards the unit shows and its 34 lexicon entries. We solved all 99 authored items blind from promptDe plus options, tiles or audio line: start gist 1, input 15, structured 12, pool 33, reserve 13, exam 10, check 8, proof 2, form fields 5. On every choice item we also ran three solvers that use no German: the option that shares most tokens with the stem, the number closest to the stem's number, and the count of list entries that contain the stem's noun. We ran 95 candidate learner answers through the real graders: items through src/lib/course-v2/checkItem.js, and the S1 fields through checkItem with the item shape of WritingTaskView.jsx l. 42 and the point rule of l. 45 (a TYPO still earns the point). We read how the player orders options (unitPlan.js shufflesOptions/orderedOptions; ItemView.jsx l. 95–96: plain tiles, no letters). We walked every German string with the validator's own knownForms + licensedForms + knownCompound at a1.1-u05, including the surfaces LEX-01 does not read. Every fix proposed below was applied to a scratch copy outside the content tree and run through validate.mjs, which ingests an outside file over the tree. The result was 0 blocker, except for the names.json entry F02 depends on. The exam blocks were checked against content/course-v2/registries/lanes/sd1.json. l2: 5 items, a/b, per-ad band 9–26. l1: 2 texts in [56, 92]; t6 has 61 words and t7 62. sp1: Stichwörter, of which not all are needed. sp2: 2 topics, cards-ask. s1: 5 fields, situation 47 words in [36, 48]. We also checked the rubrics sd1-s1 (spelling „only-if-meaning-suffers“, zeroRule „form-number-exact“) and sd1-sp1. The grammar ceiling was checked against grammar-spine.json: g.praep-dativ as a chunk from a1.1-u05 with its preposition list, g.wechselpraep at a2.1-u02, g.kein at a1.1-u06, g.koennen at a1.1-u08. The can-dos were read against registries/cando/a1.json. The cast was read against casts/series.json and casts/a1.json: Priya is 28, from Kochi, a Hotelrezeptionistin, and her languages are Malayalam, Englisch and Deutsch. Arjun is 31 and her husband. Dieter Krause is 63 and the Hausmeister. Gerda Lehmann is 79, lives in the Erdgeschoss and has been there fifty years. Amal lives with Samir and Rania. Olena lives with Sophie in a WG. Every r2 finding (and through r2, every r1 finding) was re-verified against the current file and the rails. Every finding class of u04 r1–r5 was checked for recurrence.

findings.problem: r2-F01's stop-gap works for the forms it listed. The class stays open because the checker rule was not written, and the grader has a second strict edge on f4. f4 is exact: 'name', and checkName treats every letter slip as a different name: WRONG, with no retry. So „Berliner Strase 21“, the most common A1 ß slip, and „Berlner Straße 21“ lose the point, and the screen shows the key as the right answer. The lane's own rubric scores this field on its information. It counts spelling only where meaning suffers, and only the digits fall under its exact rule (form-number-exact). The street and the house number are unambiguous, so a Goethe examiner gives the point. Extra correct information is still marked WRONG as well: „Berliner Straße Nr. 21“, „… 21, 04105 Leipzig“ (u02's postcode), „für 2 Personen“ and „verheiratet mit Priya“. So is „2 Person“, where the information is right. §9.4 rates a defensible answer that is not accepted, on a scored exam task, as MAJOR. This is the u04 r3-F01/r5-F01 class (the real grader rejects correct German), now in its third a1.1 unit. Every hand-added form only moves the edge of the problem, which is why CLAUDE.md rules out list-widening as the fix.
